//: Slidev project package manifest. Includes scripts to develop, build, and export the presentation. Dependencies chosen to match Slidev core.
name: kavia-pitchdeck-frontend
description: Kavia Pitch Deck frontend powered by Slidev. This package.json is annotated to clarify key scripts and dependencies.

scripts.//dev: Start Slidev in dev server mode with hot reload.
scripts.//build: Build the presentation as a static site using Vite.
scripts.//export: Export slides to PDF (requires Playwright for Chromium).
scripts.//format: Optional: format markdown and config files (if prettier installed).

dependencies.//: slidev brings in Vite and Vue under the hood. @slidev/theme-default provides base theme.

devDependencies.//: TypeScript is optional but useful for Vite config and component typing.
